static_traits.name: Chen Tao
static_traits.occupation: Proofreader at a greeting card company
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents; parents Married 40 years
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends, but has not yet talked to them about own 'sense of utter worthlessness'; relationship with friends somewhat strained due to feelings of inadequacy
static_traits.medical_history: Never experienced similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy in the past; without significant physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling not good enough and utterly worthless because of still Living with parents, especially stronger when with Living alone friends or when talking about living situations.
basic_info.core_demands: The increasingly worsening 'utterly worthless / not good enough' feelings have affected self-esteem and overall mood; hoping to gain support through counseling.
growth_experiences: Parents' marriage stable for 40 years, oneself long Living with parents. Recently comparing due to society's expectations of independence and friends' comments about independent living, triggering and worsening the self-feelings of 'inadequacy / utter worthlessness', recurring especially after social events or discussing living situations.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / not worthy

special_situations.event: A friend mentioning comments about independent living
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot Live independently, it means I have failed, not good enough.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to rationalize and feel grateful for Living with parents, but still avoiding discussing the topic with friends.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough,I am worthless.

special_situations.event: Spending time with Living alone friends or discussing living situations in Social situations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still Live with parents while friends already Live alone, it shows I am not as good as them.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Social withdrawal, reducing contact with friends and hobbies.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am immature, looking down on me.

special_situations.event: Boss asking to work overtime on the weekend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I refuse, I will be seen as not committed enough, possibly losing my Work.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking to the boss about boundaries and by default accepts arrangements.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot say 'no', otherwise something bad will happen.

special_situations.event: Thinking of parents' 40-year marriage and not yet able to take a vacation, and associating it with oneself still Living with parents
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still Live with parents, it means I am a useless son.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Rationalizing the status quo with gratitude, but continuously negating self-worth.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a valuable son and an independent adult
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen by others (friends, boss) as not good enough, Being rejected or suffering negative consequences
defense_goal: Maintains safety and others' approval through compliance and avoiding conflict

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, dependent son / adult
object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends, bosses) are judges and rejecters

object_relations.self_representation: A person needing their worth proven
object_relations.object_representation: The parents are stable and successful role models (implicit comparison objects)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the boss proposes weekend overtime or boundaries are suggested
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The other will negate or punish me for my refusal (transference: projecting inner insecurity onto external judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding direct refusal, responding with vague euphemistic expressions and an accommodating tone, trying not to touch conflict.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to express troubles to friends or seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If speaking up will trouble friends and be looked down on (transference: fearing that exposing vulnerability will damage relationships)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Refusing action on the grounds of 'I should not trouble others', self-blaming tone, avoiding making concrete commitments.

manifestations: Internalizing society's expectation of independence as a self-standard ('should Live alone')
Difficulty setting boundaries; worries that refusal will bring punishment
Living with parents triggering self-worth questioning
outcomes: Self-deprecation and a sense of shame

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Taking society's expectation of independence as a rigid self-worth standard ('I should Live alone')
Using others' evaluations as the basis for self-measurement

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Avoids discussing weekend overtime directly with the boss
Withdraws from external contact, reduces participation with friends and interest activities (running, games)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial and worrying about being looked down on
Unwilling to express distress to friends, worrying about 'troubling others'

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends (though not yet actively seeking help)
Work ability and position basically stable
Actively seeks counseling support; positive attitude
Able to try viewing Living with parents through rationalization and gratitude
negative_force: Introjecting social expectations as rigid self-standards, over-relying on external evaluation
Hard to set boundaries; avoids direct communication with authority/others
Catastrophically predicting consequences (refusal = Unemployment / being negated)
Social withdrawal and Sleep disturbance causing functional decline

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding communication with the boss and finding it hard to say 'no'
antecedent: Boss's request to work overtime on the weekend
Thinking of possibly being seen as not committed
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries that refusal will be punished or cost the job, catastrophic prediction of negative outcomes and dependence on external recognition
target_behavior.function: Avoids conflict and potential punishment to maintain others' approval
target_behavior.consequence: Work-life imbalance, Persistent anxiety and Decreased attention

target_behavior.behavior: Social withdrawal, reduced participation with friends and hobbies
antecedent: After social activities or topics about living situations
Comparing when spending time with Living alone friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and Self-deprecation (believing oneself not as good as others), worrying about being looked down on
target_behavior.function: Avoids exposure to evaluative and shame-inducing situations
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends, low mood and Decreased motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbance(Difficulty falling asleep/Declining sleep quality)
antecedent: Anticipating weekend overtime and the pressure of boundary setting
Persistent worry about the possibility of being negated / Unemployment
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent anxiety and high arousal, worries around self-worth and external evaluation
target_behavior.function: Although not an intentional function, it reflects hypervigilance and the maintenance of unresolved pressure
target_behavior.consequence: Declining daytime energy and focus, further worsening Low mood and Work pressure
